title: Error-Settled Share on Late-Delivery Fee Refunds - Tailwise Online and In-Store Orders
content:
**Service recovery rule - Tailwise Online and In-Store Orders.**

The late-delivery fee refund carries an error-settled share. It compares the units already refunded on return authorizations whose reason is damaged, defective, wrong item or not as described, together with the units already given a damage credit, with the units charged on the order. The share is added to the refund share.

| Error-settled units compared with the units charged on the order | Error-settled share added |
|---|---|
| Half (0.5) of the units charged or more | 25% |
| Above zero but below half | 10% |
| None | Nothing |

### What counts as error-settled units

- The units on return refund entries on the order whose reason is damaged, defective, wrong item or not as described.
- The units on damage credit entries on the order.
- Units on return refunds for changed mind or quality guarantee do not count.

The units charged are the units on all of the order's line charges.

### Both sides of the threshold (hypothetical order of 6 units)

| Error-settled units | Compared with 6 | Share added |
|---|---|---|
| 0 | none | Nothing |
| 2 | below half | 10% |
| 3 | half | 25% |
| 5 | above half | 25% |
